mechanism_narrative: The federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) at 1.58% compresses discount rates and boosts equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns through monetary policy easing.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of cases when FEDFUNDS <= 1.6%.

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate (UNRATE < 3.0%) signals a tight labor market supporting corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of cases when UNRATE < 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production (INDPRO) and employment (PAYEMS) signal an economic contraction, causing negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns due to reduced corporate demand.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of cases when INDPRO and PAYEMS both decline by >0.5% in past month.

mechanism_narrative: Low year-over-year inflation (CPIAUCSL YoY < 2.0%) indicates stable monetary conditions supporting equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of cases when CPIAUCSL YoY < 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 1.0% signals aggressive monetary easing, compressing discount rates and boosting equity valuations for positive S&P 500 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of cases when FEDFUNDS < 1.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in GDP (GDPC1) and industrial production (INDPRO) signal a demand shock, causing negative S&P 500 60-day forward returns due to reduced economic activity.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of cases when GDPC1 and INDPRO both decline by >0.5% in past quarter.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained GDP growth (GDPC1 QoQ > 0.5% for two consecutive quarters) signals strong economic conditions supporting corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 60-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 QoQ > 0.5% for two consecutive quarters
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of cases when GDPC1 QoQ > 0.5% for two consecutive quarters.

mechanism_narrative: The federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) at 1.58% is associated with positive S&P 500 60-day forward returns due to low interest rates compressing discount rates and boosting equity valuations.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of cases when FEDFUNDS <= 1.6%.
